subject: MPA for FinTechCo evaluation - please confirm owners & target dates
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@fintechco.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MPA: FinTechCo evaluation — Mutual Action Plan and next steps

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning — great context on your latency targets and data residency constraints. Per our conversation I attached the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation milestones, owners we've suggested, and a proposed timeline so your security and procurement teams have a concrete artifact to review.

Key asks in the MAP: 
- Confirm the internal owners for each workstream (integration, security review, pilot run, billing/PO).
- Confirm target delivery dates for the security questionnaire and pilot environment access.

Quick summary of the proposed owners we included: 
- Integration / sandbox setup: Priya Sharma (FinTechCo) — tentative
- Security questionnaire: Ethan Morris (FinTechCo) 
- Pilot validation: FinTechCo Product team (TBD)
- Procurement / PO: Priya (Finance)

If you can reply with the confirmed owner names and any date changes by EOD next Wednesday (Dec 8), we can lock the timeline and I’ll surface the plan to our Solutions Architect so they can reserve capacity for the pilot window. If those dates won’t work, say the word and we’ll propose an alternate.

Attachments: FinTechCo_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB), FinTechCo-kickoff-deck.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB)

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/FT-2027-042 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@fintechco.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MPA: FinTechCo evaluation — Mutual Action Plan and next steps

Thanks Jasmine — received the MAP and deck. I’ll review with Priya and our security lead (cc’d: Priya) and come back with owner confirmations. We should be able to confirm the security questionnaire owner and an initial target date by early next week.

Appreciate the clear steps — will follow up once we sync internally.

—Ethan
Ethan Morris
Senior Product Manager | FinTechCo
ethan.morris@fintechco.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@fintechco.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MPA: FinTechCo evaluation — Mutual Action Plan and next steps

Hi Ethan / Priya —

Just nudging this up the inbox — wanted to check whether you had any updates after your internal sync. We’re holding a small block of seats on the pilot cluster for the first half of January based on the timeline in the MAP, so confirming owners and the questionnaire target date will help avoid schedule slippage.

If it helps, we can do a 15-min alignment call this week to walk the MAP and pin owners — Marissa and I are available Thursday 11am–1pm PT and Friday 9–11am PT.

If I don’t hear back I’ll assume you need a little more time and will follow up again next week, but I did want to surface the pilot seat risk in case you’re aiming for that early-January window.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: ACTION REQUIRED — Lock owners & dates for FinTechCo evaluation (MPA)

Ethan / Priya —

Following up from Jasmine’s note. We want to avoid any delay that would push your pilot into late January. To keep the early-Jan pilot window we need two confirmations from your side by COB Monday Dec 13:
1) Owner names for the security questionnaire and integration (first/last and best email).
2) Confirmation of target dates for questionnaire completion and pilot environment access (even if provisional).

If you prefer a very short call to finalize both, Marissa and Jasmine can join for 15 minutes — suggested times Monday 8:30–9:00am PT or 3:00–3:30pm PT. Please let us know which slot works or reply with the two items above.

If we don’t get confirmation by Dec 13 we'll adjust the plan and the pilot window; no hard feelings — we just want to keep schedules aligned.

Thanks for the quick turnaround,
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
